constraints.long_run_research_target: 5% annualized; a test line only, not a guarantee, floor, prediction, suitability outcome, or annual promise

distinct_from_r5: C7 is fixed strategic allocation plus semiannual drift bands; R5 was monthly absolute-momentum sleeve selection.
C7 has no positive-sleeve gate, cross-sectional rank, defensive fallback, lookback window, parameter grid, or survivor-search logic.
C7 retains six structural sleeves including CSI 500 and does not select products from R5 results.
C7 does not use R5 NAV inputs, results, or pass/fail outcomes.

non_exclusion_boundary.direct_a_shares: not excluded or judged inferior; a separate research family
non_exclusion_boundary.futures: not excluded or judged inferior; actual-contract research remains a separate family
non_exclusion_boundary.other_domestic_instruments: not silently admitted to C7 and not rejected by C7

rule.allocation_regime: single fixed normal allocation; no forecast or tactical allocation switch

sleeves.exposure: SSE 5-Year Treasury Bond Index, optimized sampling
sleeves.name: 国泰上证5年期国债ETF

sleeves.exposure: domestic gold spot contracts as the primary exposure
sleeves.name: 华安黄金ETF

calendar.information_date: last common trading close in March and September
calendar.rebalancing_trigger: any sleeve's absolute difference from target exceeds its fixed weight band
calendar.rebalancing_action: restore every eligible, tradable sleeve to the fixed target; otherwise no trade

risk_and_exception_controls.drawdown_review_trigger: 12% decline from a verified unitized high-water mark requires a review record before the next rebalance; it does not alter target weights or act as a backtested stop/timing switch
risk_and_exception_controls.no_automatic_substitute: suspension, termination, material product-change, unavailable quote, missing permission, or missing required evidence sets the sleeve to not_actionable rather than selecting a replacement

order_controls.buy_price_protection: when verified IOPV and best offer exist, best offer must be no greater than 100.3% of IOPV
order_controls.sell_price_protection: when verified IOPV and best bid exist, best bid must be no less than 99.7% of IOPV
order_controls.settlement: do not presume access to unsettled sale proceeds or same-day resale of newly acquired stock ETF units

source_bound_price_screen.price_input_boundary: official SSE retrospectively retrieved close prices with undisclosed adjustment basis; neither investor total return nor executable performance
source_bound_price_screen.mechanical_cost_load: 20bp per one-way turnover; arithmetic sensitivity only, not observed costs
source_bound_price_screen.5pct_verdict: not_adjudicated: price-only numbers cannot establish total return or personal execution; they prohibit a stable-5% marketing claim

formal_test_and_disposition.required_test: frozen C7 rule over entitled PIT investor total return plus fund-event and execution ledger, after actual costs, taxes, partial fills, no fills, and settlement effects
formal_test_and_disposition.strict_hurdle: every complete calendar year and every complete rolling five-year annualized endpoint at or above 5%, with no unexplained data or accounting failure
formal_test_and_disposition.failure_action: invalidate C7 without retuning weights, bands, indicators, or products
current_blockers: PIT total return and fund-event ledger absent
historical available-at and revision lineage absent
market state, IOPV, bid/ask, depth, fees, taxes, fills, and settlement ledger absent
personal account permission, suitability, and broker route absent
independent recomputation and six-month prospective paper record absent
